sections.heading: When the Furnace or Air Conditioner Quits
body: Call (309) 676-0808 and say what the system is doing: no heat, no cooling, a noise, or it runs and the house doesn't change. Emergency services are available 24/7.
Griffin repairs furnaces and air conditioners. For the specifics, see [furnace repair in Peoria](/furnace-repair-peoria-il/) and [AC repair in Peoria](/ac-repair-peoria-il/).

sections.heading: The Griffin Maintenance Plan
body: The maintenance plan is a one-year agreement with two clean-and-check visits, one in spring and one in fall. Each visit has its own list.
Clean-and-check visits are scheduled on weekdays.

items.title: Spring visit
items.text: Condenser coil, electrical, refrigerant pressures, drains and thermostat.

items.title: Fall visit
items.text: Burners, flame sensor, safeties, gas pressures, flue and humidifier.

items.title: 10% off parts
items.text: Members get 10% off any parts during service or a clean and check.

items.title: A set service-call rate
items.text: Members never pay after-hours, weekend or holiday rates, only $75.00 for any service call.

sections.heading: What the Plan Costs
body: A one-year agreement is $160.00 for a home with 1 system (furnace and air conditioning), and $260.00 for a home with 2 systems. An extra $100.00 is added if your home has more than 2 systems.

sections.quote: Josh cleaned my HVAC unit including the blower which was filled with drywall dust from renovations. I was so impressed and have signed up for their yearly maintenance plan.

footer.about: Griffin HVAC is a Peoria heating and cooling company that has served the area since 1963, and has had its current owner since 2019. It repairs and installs furnaces and air conditioners, and offers a maintenance plan with two clean-and-check visits a year.

why: Your homepage headline reads “Please call if the online schedule doesn't show a time you want.” That is a notice, not an answer to what you do or where, and three different pages carry the title “Heating Services.” On a phone, every page is 768 pixels wide on a 390-pixel screen, so visitors scroll sideways, and the header shows Book Online and Log In but no phone number.

You have no furnace page and no AC page, and those are the two repairs your customers call about. Your maintenance plan page is a strong page: a price, two visit checklists and member rates. Today it sits behind the menu label “Maintenance Plan Agreement.”
So the demo opens with HVAC company in Peoria, IL and your 24/7 emergency service, gives furnace repair and AC repair a page each, and explains the plan before it gives the price.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the HVAC Company People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one page of the demo.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: Where Google learns who you are and where you work.
problems: Your headline is an online-schedule notice, and your page title leads with “Heating Services,” a title shared by three pages.
The raw page carries “Slide title” template filler 15 times, which sits in the page code where Google can read it.
fixes: A headline that says HVAC company in Peoria, IL, with emergency service and your phone in the first screen.
A homepage that tells your services, your towns and your plan, explained first and priced after.
cards.alsoAdd: On day one, we sit down with you to get what makes you the obvious choice, every service you offer and every town you work in. From that we plan how many pages, in how many towns, so Google and AI tools can find you for every service.

cards.title: Furnace Repair
cards.why: When the heat is out, people call the first company they reach.
problems: You have no furnace repair page, so a search for furnace repair in Peoria has nothing built for it.
Your plan page, your homepage and your video page share one title, “Heating Services.”
fixes: A page for furnace repair in Peoria, IL, with why to call Griffin, what happens on the call, replacement and the fall visit.
Your own customers' words about furnace calls, placed next to the repair.
cards.alsoAdd: A check of what your competitors offer, so services you didn’t think to mention still get their own pages.

cards.title: AC Repair
cards.why: On a hot day, people call the first company they reach.
problems: You have no AC repair page, so a search for AC repair in Peoria has nothing built for it.
fixes: A page for AC repair in Peoria, IL, with why to call Griffin, what happens on the call, replacement and the spring visit.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: Where a customer with a dead system decides to call.
problems: Your contact page is 114 words, is titled “Heating Maintenance,” and puts a visible reCAPTCHA in front of the form.
Your homepage says Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 6:00, and your contact page says 8:00 to 5:00.
fixes: One number, one email, one address and one set of hours together on one page.
What to tell us when you call, so the first minute of the call counts.
cards.alsoAdd: Call and form tracking that shows which pages and towns your leads come from.

items: Your homepage, financing page and plan page say Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 6:00, while your contact page says 8:00 to 5:00, so what closing time should every listing show?
